protocol: Hypothesis test only, not production refinement: adjacent nonempty single-baseline model bands, positive common horizontal extent >=80% smaller width, median glyph-height ratio >=0.9, baseline distance <=2x larger median height and >0. Native horizontal source rules between baselines veto. Same fixed gate every boundary in both pinned pages. Read only prior model bands/source identity, never XML/text/row labels into proposal gate. No inference/model/relabel/score repair. Original scores retained; source-reference comparisons for diagnosis only. Reject production adoption if legitimate distinct rows remain eligible.
